verdict_note: From reading only (no build, no tests): nothing found at c43f2d90 that breaks the build or a test the bundled run will execute. Items 1, 2, 5, 6, 7 and 8 close their probes as described. Items 1 and 2 ask the port once, before any render or byte, with typed refusals and one settlement. Item 6 makes delete and records one undo step. The guard handles trailing dots and spaces in any case, and edge_gaps and the Hug clamp hold at scales 1, 1.25 and 2 without flagging SMB-GUI-FRAME-1's frame. The builder is already changing code for the two named defects (the free-text id scan and the batch export on a fresh local port). Fold in F1 and F2 at the same time, since both are cheap. F1: a sized layout.open is now declared mutating, but the drive still reports undo_name null. F2: page.add stays refused while a page key page-18446744073709551615 sits in the document or the history, even after the free-text fix. Then do one bundled run. F3 is the same probe class on export routes outside this brief. The lead assigns it.

findings.severity: receipt that lies (MEDIUM): the drive says a mutating command made no undo step
findings.where: crates/hsk-studio-harness/src/cli/drive.rs:300-307 (for layout.* rows undo_name = result["undo_name"]); crates/hsk-studio-harness-view/src/view/commands/layout.rs:126-134 (layout.open answered by output(), no undo_name); crates/hsk-studio-harness-view/src/view/layout_export.rs:509-525 (layout_open commits the step 'layout.open' at :512 and returns {document_id, pages, stories, frames})
findings.what: Item 6b flips the layout.open row to mutates_authority true (action/commands/layout.rs:54). The drive's typed() reads undo_name for every layout.* row from the command result, and layout.open's result has no undo_name key, so the reply carries undo_name null even when the sized open added the 'layout.open' undo step. The probe class (mutating-row-declared-non-mutating) names that drive symptom, and it stays after the flag change. The new test r60_i3 checks the row and the history length but never the drive reply.
findings.scenario: Drive a session over a Vector document with no pages: command layout.open page_width_pt=200 page_height_pt=200 pages=1. Reply: {result: {...}, undo_name: null}, while run().history()["undo"] now ends in 'layout.open'.
findings.fix: In drive typed(), use result["undo_name"] only when the result carries that key, and otherwise fall back to the newest-step comparison that other rows use. Or have layout_open add "undo_name": "layout.open" when it committed. Add a drive assert to r60_i3. Both files are outside the brief's owned paths, so record the file under notes.beyond_brief_paths after the lead's approval.

findings.severity: wrong answer (MEDIUM): page.add refused permanently while page keys are free
findings.where: crates/hsk-studio-harness-core/src/harness/containers.rs:167-186 (next_page_number = highest page-N + 1 via checked_add); :421 (None -> page_number_exhausted); Folio key rule [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128} (crates/hsk-studio-folio/src/layout.rs:24, validate_pages :451) accepts page-18446744073709551615
findings.what: The mint starts past the highest page-N that the document, the history (container and now layout steps) or an entry names. One page key at u64::MAX makes next_page_number None. Every later page.add then refuses page_number_exhausted, even though page-1 and every other low key are free and MAX_PAGES is far off. The named free-text fix removes the story-text trigger only. A page key that Folio accepts in a hostile or imported package still triggers it, and so does a key that the undo or redo history still holds.
findings.scenario: Open a valid package whose only page is page-18446744073709551615. page.add returns page_number_exhausted, and so does every later call. The refusal stays after deleting that page, as long as the delete step is on the undo stack.
findings.fix: When highest.checked_add(1) is None, mint the lowest n >= 1 that no page key names. The keys to avoid come from the document, the history's container and layout documents, and the entry page keys that next_page_number already gathers. Collect them into a set, which is bounded by MAX_PAGES plus the history. Refuse page_number_exhausted only if that search fails. Add a test: a document page key page-18446744073709551615, then page.add returns a page and a second page.add returns another.

findings.severity: same probe class on other routes (export-job-not-admitted-jobport; outside this brief's items)
findings.where: crates/hsk-studio-harness-view/src/view/mod.rs:705 Viewer::export (drive viewer.export drive_viewer.rs:333, shell Export PNG/JPEG shell.rs:1364-1365, cli export cli.rs:1075); develop.rs:1085 export_develop (develop.rs:1402, cli.rs:870); vector/interop.rs:616 export_vector_svg and vector/pdf_export.rs:372 export_vector_pdf (hosted.rs:1414-1415, drive_viewer.rs:348-349); audio_import.rs:935 export_audio
findings.what: None of these call the JobPort: no admission and no settlement before write_atomic or write_new. The lead's common ruling covers every export. With a saturated port bound through set_job_port, each of these writes its file, and the port is asked 0 times. That is the j1 evidence on another route. The named RecipeTargets fresh-port defect (doc_export.rs:982) is a fifth route and is already being fixed.
findings.scenario: Call set_job_port(saturated) and then viewer.export(path, Png, false). Result: Ok, file written, asks 0. export_vector_svg, export_vector_pdf, export_develop and export_audio behave the same way.
findings.fix: Wrap each entry point the way export_document now is: admit_export_job() after the cheap path checks, then settle_export_job(). The lead decides whether that happens in this lane (beyond_brief_paths) or in a follow-up lane.

lead_questions: F1: the fix touches cli/drive.rs or view/layout_export.rs, both outside the owned paths. Approve one of them for this lane?
F3: who owns admission for Viewer::export, export_develop, export_vector_svg/pdf and export_audio? In this lane the change is beyond_brief_paths; the other option is a follow-up lane.

Named batch defect (doc_export.rs:975-990, RecipeTargets::write makes Viewer::with_context with the default AdmissionJobPort): the only product caller is cli.rs:652, with asset_local_test_context(). Which port should the batch admit through? Whatever the answer, the port must be asked exactly once per target. Bind the inner viewer with set_job_port to the caller's port and let its export_document admit, or admit in write(). Never do both.

The ruling says to refuse only where a record cannot follow, with each case named. Accept the graphic-frame refusal and the catch-all as written?

Item 1 (READ, doc_export.rs:866-904): path, source and nothing_open checks come first. admit_export_job asks the viewer port once, through job_admission() (job_admission.rs:207), before prepared_text, render or write. Typed refusals come from refusal_json. A canceled refusal settles Canceled and any other refusal settles Failed(code), on the render cancel code 'canceled' (render.rs:365) and the psd/cmyk codes. A panic drops the ticket as Abandoned (session jobs.rs:552). bound == head, so stale_revision cannot fire, the same as as_export_job (layout_export.rs:543).

Item 2 (READ, export_set.rs:489-677): every plan refusal (dir, nothing_open, settings, too_many, colour, too_large, name, collision, over_source, destination_exists) comes before the single admit_export_job. write_planned keeps partial() naming the files written before a failure. resample and render cancels return code 'canceled' and settle Canceled.

Item 4 (READ): mint_page_id uses checked_add and ends after at most pages+1 steps. next_page_number returns None on overflow and add_page refuses page_number_exhausted, with no loop. mint_child_id uses wrapping_add over an effectively unbounded space, and the other id minters (layout_ui/pages.rs:148, project.rs:73, timeline.rs:1091, place.rs, layers.rs) terminate. The free-text scan (containers.rs:181-184 over DOCUMENT_ENTRY_TOKENS including text and layout_records) is the named defect.

Item 5 (READ, reel export.rs:926-957): 'x.vtt ', 'x.VTT.', 'x.Vtt . .' resolve to x.vtt and are refused before the first frame. Rust's extension of 'x.vtt ' is 'vtt ', so with_extension yields x.vtt. ADS 'x.vtt:s' and 'x.vtt::$DATA' are not caught by the guard, but the media temp '.x.vtt:s.partial-..' or '.x.vtt::$DATA.partial-..' (temp_beside :786) is a stream path. That temp fails at create_new or at the rename (std rename/hard_link of a stream onto another file's stream), so nothing is published (UNVERIFIED on a live NTFS). Device names (COM1.vtt and NUL.vtt on Windows 10): the media rename to the device fails first, giving a typed Failed (UNVERIFIED).

Item 6 (READ, containers.rs:46-66, 143-186, 508-583; harness.rs:2053-2102): delete and records commit as one submit_layout step labelled 'delete_page <page>', whose inverse restores the document and the records together. Records that change nothing still validate against the successor (:582), so the delete never leaves a stale entry. Stale or unreadable records fall back to the container step. remembered_container_ids and next_page_number include the documents in the history's layout steps, so a spread or page removed by a layout step is not re-minted while the undo can return it. Parent overrides live in the binding (folio parentpages.rs:93-101), so retain drops them with it. The section move respects the first-page rule (folio longdoc.rs:664).

Item 6b: readers of mutates_authority are drive.rs:307, motion_commands.rs:342/387 (motion rows only), and the catalog and manual output. No harness-view gate reads it, so layout.open without a document is not refused. Test pins: layout_pdf_host.rs:237 (updated); action_records, document_new, harness_drive_audio and web_host pin other rows.

Item 7 (READ, checks.rs:109-117): snap edge rounding gives the probe pair 1 px at scale 1, 1 px at 1.25 (125 vs 126) and 2 px at 2.
